source.stem:
Problem:

Grandmother's Cakes — Sofia was taking sweets to her grandmother: 7 blackberry, 6 coconut, and 3 chocolate sweets. On the way, the hungry Sofia eats 2 sweets. Which of the following situations is possible?

(A) Grandmother received no chocolate sweets.
(B) Grandmother received fewer coconut sweets than chocolate sweets.
(C) Grandmother received the same number of sweets of each of the 3 flavors.
(D) There are 2 flavors of which grandmother received the same number of sweets.
(E) The number of blackberry sweets grandmother received is greater than the total number of the other 2 flavors.

options.text: Grandmother received fewer coconut sweets than chocolate sweets.
Grandmother received the same number of sweets of each of the 3 flavors.

There are 2 flavors of which grandmother received the same number of sweets.
(E) The number of blackberry sweets grandmother received is greater than the total number of the other 2 flavors.
